methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series G → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.25x) to $75M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Earth AI is a Series G infrastructure and logistics company founded by Roman Teslyuk that has raised $20M to date. No public comparables or identifiable private peers are available in the sector at this stage, limiting traditional multiples-based triangulation.

The valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 1.25x step-up multiplier to a $75M total-raised proxy baseline. This approach yields an implied valuation of $94M. The methodology assumes typical venture capital step-ups between funding rounds at the Series G stage but does not incorporate market multiples, revenue metrics, or growth rates given data constraints.

The triangulated range extends from $80M (low) to $108M (high), with $94M as the median estimate. This narrow 35% range reflects reliance on a single method rather than convergence across multiple valuation approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable company data to validate stage-appropriate markups, unknown revenue or unit economics, and the applicability of standard venture step-ups to infrastructure-focused companies, which may command different return profiles than software or consumer sectors.
